text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma said on Thursday its earnings outlook for the full-year had not changed during the second quarter.

Rauma has earlier said it expects profitability to be steady this year. Last year, it posted a 679 million markka profit after financial items, 6.6 percent of net sales, and its return on equity was 19.2 percent.
"The projections for the entire year have not changed during the second quarter," Rauma said in a statement with its first half results. @
"The outlook for 1997 and Rauma corporation's longer-term market prospects in particular are positive," Rauma said.

Rauma reported first half profit after financial items falling to 318 million markka -- 6.5 percent of net sales -- from 341 million in the year-ago period. First half return on equity fell to 16.8 percent from 19.7 percent a year earlier.
The first half profit exactly matched the median of analysts' forecasts in a Reuters poll.
